content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH: Dedicated pool 'dedicated-eo-01' GPU saturation >99% for 4m, request queue 520. Tenant: enterprise-eon. severity=P1.

vivian: ack. I'm oncall. pulling cluster + pool status.

raj: seeing bursts of `cudaMalloc` failures and kube autoscaler errors: `insufficient quota dedicated_gpu` — looks like the tenant reached their reserved capacity.

oliver: FYI this tenant has strict contract clause: no traffic to shared infra unless emergency and signed escape clause. ops must approve emergency move.

vivian: quick diagnostics:
```
pool: dedicated-eo-01
  total_gpus: 16 used: 16 queued_reqs: 520
pods:
  infer-0: latency p50 290ms p95 2.8s errors: OOM
  infer-7: GPU mem pressure 99%
autoscaler: attempted scale -> request denied: quotaExceeded(dedicated_gpu_pool_quota)
```

tess: support-bot opened INC-7902 for enterprise-eon. I'm prepping customer note.

support-bot: INC-7902 created and linked to thread. Priority: P1. Owner: tess.

vivian: proposed mitigations: (A) immediate traffic shed / rate-limit for tenant (but would impact customer SLAs); (B) live-migrate some traffic to shared-burst with tenant encryption + namespace isolation (requires ops lead + security signoff); (C) fallback to smaller model variant (quantized) with degraded accuracy; (D) attempt preemptible spot nodes if cloud quota allows.

oliver: product: moving to shared-burst is only allowed with documented emergency flow. ops-lead must approve. Security needs to verify KMS and network isolation.

raj: also can try lowering per-request batch sizes from 128 -> 32 to relieve alloc pressure, may reduce throughput but prevent OOM.

security-bot: Automated note: tenant-eon is under compliance profile 'enterprise-high'. Any shared-pool migration requires ephemeral key scoping + post-migration key rotation.

vivian: executing non-invasive changes now: reducing batch size and enabling model fallback threshold. commands:
```
infractl set-config --pool dedicated-eo-01 --model-batch-size 32
routectl set-override --tenant enterprise-eon --route /v1/chat --fallback-model gpt-eon-quant --threshold 0.9
```

vivian: after those changes: queue dropped 520 -> 210 within 4m. p95 dropped from 2.8s -> 1.5s. still high but better.

oliver: I'll page ops-lead for emergency shared-burst override. pinging @ops-lead.

ops-lead: on it. I'm reviewing contract. If engineering can ensure per-tenant encryption at rest/in-transit and limit access, I can approve a 3h emergency migration. Please confirm rotation plan.

vivian: we will keep KMS keys scoped, do ephemeral creds for new nodes, and rotate keys after migration. we'll also enable packet-level policies for tenant namespace.

ops-lead: approve emergency override for 3h. Use `opsctl override-burst` with `--audit=true`.

vivian: running ops command now.
```
opsctl override-burst --tenant enterprise-eon --to shared-burst --ttl 3h --audit=true || echo "opsctl failed"
```

incident-bot: Action logged: burst override requested. Awaiting infra confirmation.

raj: infra reports override applied. starting live-migration of new requests to shared-burst.

vivian: migration cmd: `tenant-shift --tenant enterprise-eon --from dedicated-eo-01 --to shared-burst --live --preserve-kms` 

support-bot: Customer notification sent: "We detected service degradation affecting latency. We're executing an emergency mitigation which may cause temporary model quality changes. We'll follow up with details."

tess: customer replied: "We need ETA and assurance no data will be accessed by other tenants."

vivian: replied to customer: "ETA ~30-45m for stabilization. Data remains encrypted; we maintain tenant isolation via namespace and key scoping during migration. We'll rotate keys afterward."

raj: migration in-flight. queue decreased from 210 -> 30 in 12m. p95 now ~700ms.

security-bot: Confirmed: per-tenant network policy enforced on shared-burst nodes; ephemeral creds issued; KMS access limited to tenant principal. Key rotation scheduled at TTL expiry.

ops-lead: monitor for noisy neighbor; set autoscaler scaling policy to prefer tenant-affinity.

vivian: all good. moving to monitoring and will prepare postmortem. handoff to oliver for evening watch.

oliver: taking handoff. will watch for error regressions and verify key rotation at 3h mark. linking runbook: https://internal/runbooks/tenant-emergency-burst

tess: adding follow-ups to INC-7902: 
- review quota and contract limits for enterprise-eon
- define pre-approved emergency flow for high-compliance tenants
- implement autoscaler better errors (quota-exceeded fallback)

vivian: timeline: 
- 1766009012: alert triggered
- 1766009030: oncall ack + diag
- 1766009100: batch size + fallback applied
- 1766009300: ops approved override
- 1766009410: migration started
- 1766009710: queue drained & latencies improved
- 1766009800: handoff to ops watch

tess: scheduling post-incident review tomorrow 09:00 UTC. inviting product, ops, security, legal, account.

incident-bot: Incident INC-7902 tagged for postmortem.

vivian: thanks team. assigning action items in ticket. :thumbsup:
